title: Supra Mayro Bross 3DS
description: resceu princes from bigger gumba (Supra Mayro Bross: Legend of the Lost Kingdom remake for the Nintendo 3DS)
long_description:
"Supra Mayro Bross - Legend of the Lost Kingdom is an emotional and exciting story of Mayro, as he goes on a minute long journey to defeat the Bigger Gumba." Supra Mayro Bross: Legend of the Lost Kingdom remake for the Nintendo 3DS with few changes, dual screen UI adaptation and new music.

This game has been rewritten from scratch by misakii-p in C for 3DS consoles. Assets have been taken from the original Flash game. (Except the new music and bottom screen art)
